requirements_at_install: Test lines cut; no stops / valves installed - capped stubs only (Andriy 2026-11-06).
scope_rule: Andriy 2026-11-04: only what touches UCON cabinetry: rough-ins inside / behind our units, appliance feeds in their zones, blocking.
decisions_2026_11_08: Red-handle valve = gas shutoff, not the range feed; range feed = stub with gauge just right of the range CL.
Sink drains: offset from the CL is fine, but inside the sink unit.
Fridge niche -17 in height: trim the top fillers.
Island microwave drawer: any brand, floor box in the niche corner.
Boxes ~2050 on wall 3 = LED receptacles in the wall units.
Trash pull-out motor receptacle inside the sink 1 unit.
Gas shutoff behind unit 300: cabinet installer fits a 6x9 plastic access panel; GC rotates the valve if it interferes.
Wall units / hood box < 500 mm deep: top blocking row only, no bottom row, no supports (v0.2).
